study type: Retrospective cohort study with a historical control group
outcome: Infant motor development (Alberta Infant Motor Scale)
Cognitive development (Bayley Scales of Infant Development II)
Language development (Sequenced Language Scale for Infants)
cohort: The study included 246 preterm infants with corrected ages of 0-3 months, divided into a control group (n=145) and an education group (n=101).
finding: Group-based early parent education improved development in preterm infants, particularly in those born before 28 weeks' gestational age and in infants with no or mild brain injury.
gest_age: Preterm infants, with a subgroup analysis for those born before 28 weeks' gestational age.
